items.information: The venue for the competition is different on each day of the competition. Please see the Venue tab for full details. * **Friday** and **Saturday** will be in the Fireside Lounge at **Rooker Hall.** * **Sunday** will be in the Ballroom at **Memorial Hall**. To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. Inproper completion of these steps may result in a delay of Registration. If you do not see your name on the compeitors tab after 48 hours of registering, please contact the organizers to resolve the issue. There will be a costume contest on Sunday! Happy Halloween!

items.name: UK Championship 2017
items.information: Registration opens on Friday 11th August, 7pm BST. The steps for registration are as follows: * Register for the competition on the left. * Pay the £20 flat fee as instructed through the WCA system. * Once we have confirmed correct payment, we will accept your registration. This fee is non-refundable, as it represents a commitment to attending the competition. There is a competitor limit of 250. As this is the UK Championship, only competitors representing the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.
